integrity: The complex norm was already computed by Derksen. The local real complex-multiplication nuclear norm was already known. Only the exact real group-wide assembly and sharp two-torsion field comparison are asserted as new.
scientific_limitations: The exact formula concerns finite abelian groups and the real threefold Hilbertian projective norm with counting-measure Euclidean coordinates. It does not classify nonabelian real group algebras; independent review and publication-priority determination have not occurred.
title: The real nuclear norm of finite abelian convolution tensors
